title: form-bug-hunt preflight fails post-migration: generate-fixtures.sh cds into gitignored fixtures/ that no checkout has at the new .pi path
evidence: generate-fixtures.sh lines 23-26: `set -eu` ... `cd "$(dirname "$0")/fixtures"` — no mkdir anywhere in the script. .gitignore:95: `.pi/skills/form-bug-hunt/helpers/fixtures/` (dir is untracked). SKILL.md:152-153 preflight (changed in this chunk): `bash .pi/skills/form-bug-hunt/helpers/generate-fixtures.sh` / `FIXTURES_DIR="$(cd .pi/skills/form-bug-hunt/helpers/fixtures && pwd)"`. Verified live in the worktree: `bash .pi/skills/form-bug-hunt/helpers/generate-fixtures.sh` → exit=1, `line 26: cd: .pi/skills/form-bug-hunt/helpers/fixtures: No such file or directory`.
detail: Fixtures were generated at the old .claude path in existing checkouts; untracked dirs don't follow a git rename, so every consumer's first run of the migrated preflight aborts on the cd until fixtures/ is created by hand.
recommended_fix: Add `mkdir -p "$(dirname "$0")/fixtures"` immediately before the `cd` in generate-fixtures.sh (or a mkdir line in the SKILL.md preflight) so the idempotent generator self-bootstraps at the new path.
